manual.description: Pair Windows to Android twenty consecutive times with fresh identities and no duplicate contact.
Pair Android to Windows twenty consecutive times with fresh identities and no duplicate contact.
Queue text and image messages while the recipient is offline, restart both clients and verify exactly-once delivery.
Remove the relationship with both history policies, verify symmetric blocking, then pair again with fresh MLS state.
Verify deduplication, current-conversation suppression, cold-start deep link and alert clearing.
Install on a clean platform profile, complete onboarding, pair and exchange messages.
Upgrade from the previous signed 0.1 candidate and verify identity, contacts, history, queue, attachment cache and preferences are preserved.
Exercise tray/background lifecycle, process termination, Tor loss and network recovery without fatal UI state.
Verify manual and automatic image download, encrypted cache usage/clearing and explicit gallery export.
Export diagnostics after real messaging and independently verify no plaintext, image payload or key material is present.
